title: Sunday Book Review (Tom Fox) — Incorruptible on the compliance-leader summer reading list
summary: Tom Fox — the longtime compliance-industry commentator behind the Compliance Podcast Network — dedicates his weekly Sunday Book Review to four FT-picked summer reads for compliance leaders, with Incorruptible sitting alongside Henry Snow's Control Science, Xiao Hai's Adrift in the South, and Justin Baer's House of Fidelity.
blockquote: What can four summer reads on environment, science, and technology teach compliance leaders about integrity, resilience, risk, and the future of business? In this #SundayBookReview, I consider Control Science by Henry Snow, Incorruptible by Eric Ries, Adrift in the South by Xiao Hai, and House of Fidelity by Justin Baer.
